arxiv.title: OE full-schema → modeling lenses (arxiv-grounded)

papers.title: The SIDO Performance Model for League of Legends
papers.use: Gold = resource gain; damage = resource use. Condition damage on damage-taken (aggression). Champion effects as random effects — we use role Ridge residuals as champ effects.

papers.title: League of Legends: Real-Time Result Prediction
papers.use: Feature importance shifts by elapsed time: kills/dragons/towers early; total gold later. Use multipoint gold diffs + objectives, not a single snapshot.

papers.title: MOBA-Slice: Time Slice Relative Advantage
papers.use: Value network over time slices — phase gold/XP/CS curves as advantage trajectory.

papers.title: The Art of Drafting
papers.use: Draft as combinatorial game; blind vs counter value — already in Blade-Chest path.

papers.title: PandaSkill — role-specific performance from player stats
papers.use: Role-independent models of in-game stats → performance score. We residualize within role.

papers.title: DraftRec
papers.use: Synergy/competence from compositions — complements counterability, not OE stats.

papers.title: Online Learning of Counter Categories and Ratings
papers.use: Rating + residual counter table — Blade-Chest counterability path.

arxiv.objective_note: void_grubs / atakhans / dragons / towers / barons / heralds joined from OE team rows onto player games by game_uid+side; champ obj residual vs role.
arxiv.tier_formula: tier_score = elo_pp - λ·cb_tax + clip(oe_pp) where oe_pp = 0.32·fight + 0.24·lane + 0.12·vision + 0.12·tower + 0.20·obj
